result.topic_en: Gauss used the back of a printed publisher's notice (subscription terms for a Genoa journal) as scrap paper for differential calculations with partial derivatives of functions ξ, η, ζ of x and y, probably connected with surface theory.

methods.what: Differential equation summing over the coordinate functions ξ, η, ζ: products of (∂/∂x · dy − ∂/∂y · dx) with the differential of the total differential, set equal to zero
Combination of partial derivatives with differentials dη, dζ, set to zero
Collecting the coefficients of dη and dζ as Jacobian-type determinants, together with a term in ddξ
Abbreviations for the partial derivatives of ξ
